product_overview: DuduFisio-AI is an integrated management system for physiotherapy clinics combining traditional clinical management features with advanced Artificial Intelligence assistance to optimize patient care, clinical documentation, and operational management.
core_goals: Digitize and automate clinical physiotherapy processes
Enhance the quality of clinical documentation using AI
Increase operational efficiency and patient satisfaction
key_features: Comprehensive patient management including detailed profiles, medical histories, and interactive pain mapping
Robust appointment scheduling system supporting multiple therapists, recurrence, conflict prevention and notifications
Rich SOAP notes editor with auto-saving, version control, templates and AI-generated clinical reports
AI Assistant providing automatic report generation, treatment protocol suggestions, risk analysis, and clinical inquiry responses
Therapeutic exercise library with categorized, multimedia rich and personalized prescription capabilities
Secure patient portal for access to health records, prescribed exercises, and communication
Interactive dashboards and reports with financial and clinical analytics
Full financial management with payment tracking, invoicing and multiple payment methods support
Inventory management with stock alerts and transaction history
Task management system with prioritization, progress tracking and notifications
user_flow_summary: Administrator logs in to access full system controls, financial dashboards, and manage users and inventory
Physiotherapist manages patient records, documents clinical evolutions using the editor with optional AI assistance, schedules sessions and prescribes exercises
Intern accesses limited patient and scheduling views for observational purposes
Patients log into the portal to view their medical records, follow exercises and request appointments
Users interact with AI features to transcribe spoken notes, generate structured SOAP notes, suggest exercises, and compile progress summaries
validation_criteria: System supports role-based authentication and access control with secure session management
Patient management supports complete data input, search with filters, and interactive pain mapping
Appointment system prevents scheduling conflicts and handles recurring events correctly
SOAP documentation editor autosaves inputs and manages version histories effectively
AI-generated content meets 95% accuracy in clinical reports and suggestions
Patient portal allows secure access to personalized data and communication with the clinic
Dashboards reflect accurate operational, clinical and financial metrics with export capability
System meets performance standards of under 2-second page load times and 99.5% uptime
Compliance with data protection laws including encryption and audit logging is ensured

features.name: AI Audio Transcription
features.description: Transcreve áudio do fisioterapeuta em texto usando Google Gemini 1.5 Flash. Permite gravação de evolução falada com conversão automática para texto.

features.name: AI SOAP Structuring
features.description: Estrutura automaticamente texto livre em formato SOAP (Subjetivo, Objetivo, Avaliação, Plano) usando IA do Gemini Pro.

features.name: AI Exercise Suggestion
features.description: Sugere exercícios terapêuticos baseados no diagnóstico, local da dor, limitações funcionais e objetivos do paciente usando IA.

features.name: AI Progress Summary
features.description: Gera resumos profissionais do progresso do paciente ao longo de múltiplas sessões usando IA do Gemini.

features.name: Evolution Editor
features.description: Editor completo para registro de evolução de pacientes com integração de IA. Permite registro manual ou assistido por IA.

features.name: Patient Management
features.description: Sistema completo de gerenciamento de pacientes incluindo listagem, detalhes, histórico médico e evoluções.

features.name: Appointment Scheduling
features.description: Sistema de agendamento com calendário semanal, suporte a múltiplos terapeutas e agendamentos recorrentes.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Sistema de autenticação com login/logout e gerenciamento de sessão de usuário.

features.name: Financial Management
features.description: Dashboard financeiro com tracking de receitas, pagamentos e relatórios analíticos.

features.name: Treatment Tracking
features.description: Acompanhamento de tratamentos com notas de sessão, progresso e condutas terapêuticas.
